arguments.summary: No qualifying Dallas industrial executed lease comps within 8 miles dated 2025-09-01 through 2026-08-31. Most nearby executed records were amended into the Seattle market prior to the cutoff (effective 2026-08-20), and the remaining Dallas records were missing required elements (positive rent, TI, free months, term, or gross expense) or were outside radius/date/publish constraints. A comp-grid XLSX with a note has been created (artifacts/underwriting-v1.xlsx).
limitations: No executed Dallas industrial comps in-range met all business rules before the cutoff, so no effective rent calculations were possible.
Decisions rely on provided publication/effective dates; if earlier evidence exists but was not supplied, results may differ.
Distances and field values are taken as provided; no external verification or enrichment was performed.
